In detail

Praha 14 is one of Prague's 57 official mestske casti (city districts). Policie CR (the Czech national police) recorded 4,549 incidents here in 2024 across a population of 50,525 residents — a rate of 9,003 incidents per 100,000 residents, roughly 0.7× the citywide average, below it. This rate is calculated against registered residents, not footfall, so a busy central/tourist district can read higher without that meaning it is unusually risky to walk through, and a quiet residential district can show a low rate simply by having few incidents relative to its population. This is Wandroz's official-data layer for Prague — real Policie CR incident data and real CSU population figures, not a qualitative or press-based judgment — and the source data is not split here by time of day, so both figures shown here are the same.

Frequently asked questions

Is Praha 14 safe?

Wandroz currently rates Praha 14 in Prague, Czechia as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Prague, Czechia, based on Policie ČR's 2024 registered incidents (kriminalita.policie.gov.cz) and CSU population data. This source has no time-of-day breakdown, so this is one overall level rather than a separately measured day and night figure — see the note on this page before treating the day/night badges as independently measured.

Does Praha 14's rating cover night-time safety specifically?

Not separately. Policie ČR's 2024 registered incidents (kriminalita.policie.gov.cz) and CSU population data publishes one figure per zone with no time-of-day split, so Praha 14's day and night badges show the same underlying level rather than an independently measured night figure. Treat it as a general indicator, not a night-specific measurement.

Is Praha 14 a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Praha 14's rating is a useful general indicator, but this data is normalised against registered residents, not visitor footfall — busy tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher without that meaning elevated risk for a visitor passing through. You can search accommodation already filtered to this specific area using the Booking.com link on this page.

What official data is Praha 14's rating based on?

Policie ČR's 2024 registered incidents (kriminalita.policie.gov.cz) and CSU population data, covering Praha 14's real administrative boundary.
